rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a disease or person that can pass an infection on.

example.english: This kind of flu is infectious, so everyone should remember to wear a mask.
example.traditional: 呢種流感會傳染，大家記得戴口罩。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 lau4 gam2 wui5 cyun4 jim5 daai6 gaa1 gei3 dak1 daai3 hau2 zaau3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose figurative choice for a smile, behavior, or music that spreads excitement or feeling.

example.english: Their smile is infectious, making everyone laugh along.
example.traditional: 佢一笑就好有感染力，搞到成班人都跟住笑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 siu3 zau6 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6 gaau2 dou3 sing4 baan1 jan4 dou1 gan1 zyu6 siu3

rows.note: Use this mainly for music or media that is irresistibly catchy, repetitive, or oddly compelling rather than simply appealing.

example.english: This song is truly infectious; it keeps playing in my head after I hear it.
example.traditional: 呢首歌真係好魔性，聽完之後成日喺個腦入面播。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 mo1 sing3 teng1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 hai2 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 bo3
